raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly assumed the first place mentioned by name in the Book of Esther (NIV) was Susa and mapped it to Iran without verifying the text. In the NIV, the first named place is “India” (Esther 1:1: “from India to Cush”). This misidentification led the workflow to look up Iran’s Prime Minister (Amir-Abbas Hoveyda) instead of India’s, yielding the wrong final answer instead of the correct Morarji Desai.
